title: Naan Bread
description: Buttery, puffed naan bread made from self-raising flour, semi-skimmed milk and melted butter. Grilled until brown — perfect for soaking up curries.

ingredients.text: 250g self-raising flour, plus extra for kneading

steps: Sift the flour into a bowl and slowly add the milk, then 2 tablespoons of the butter. Mix and bring together into a firm dough.
Knead on a floured surface for about 10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Leave in an oiled bowl covered with a tea towel for an hour.
Split into 4 balls and roll out to about 0.5cm thick in teardrop shapes.
Preheat the grill to medium with a baking sheet underneath to heat up.
Transfer naans to the sheet, brush with the remaining butter and grill for 15 minutes until brown and puffed. Flip and grill for 5 more minutes.
notes: Makes 4 small naans. Flavour with garlic paste, desiccated coconut or chopped herbs.
